title: The newest-game jump: statics a class made instance methods, and jar-in-jar mods
text: Read from the newest jump's own types of break. Its mods each need several types; what alone holds back the most there: data id gone 3 (already counted as linked: data files), call, game: linked 2, call, game: template 1, field, game: linked 1, mixin target changed signature 1 (agent 2). Taken: call, game: linked. Statics a class made instance methods go through the accessor the game's own code uses for the class's other such methods (NeoForge 1.21.9: FMLLoader.getCurrent()). mmt port --jar ports a NeoForge jar-in-jar container by its nested mods.
finish: port.jar-links.newest up from 15, every update and big updates no lower, load on 26.3 server and client for every newly linked standalone mod
wrongIf: a mod that links through an accessor reading fails in a real game
result: 2026-11-21: newest 15 -> 16 (NeoForge 1.21.1 -> 26.3 10 -> 11, Kotlin for Forge); every update 6,044 -> 6,045 and big updates 1,924 -> 1,925, none lower. Kotlin for Forge ported with mmt port --jar loads on a real NeoForge 26.3 server and client (FML lists Kotlin For Forge 5.13.0). Next on the jump: Mouse Tweaks, held only by CycleButton.builder(f) whose starting value 26.3 takes as an argument (builder(f, v)) where the old builder took it later (withInitialValue(v)); 23 mods on the jump call it.
